verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM's core architecture runs entirely locally with no data leaving the device by default, and a developer explicitly confirmed on Hacker News that external LLM/embedder/vector-db usage is opt-in per component, meaning users can keep all data local and never send it to third-party model providers for training. Multiple docs reinforce local-only processing for documents and meeting transcription.  missing for 10: explicit written data-training policy/DPA language, independent audit of no-retention claims for optional cloud connections.
